title: VOOL App – charge your EV when electricity is cheapest
description: Free app for your VOOL charger. Smart Charging follows Nord Pool prices and saves up to 30% on charging costs.

sections.title: Your car charges when electricity is cheapest
sections.lead: Set when the car must be ready. The free VOOL App follows hourly prices and does the rest. Users save up to 30% on charging costs.

items.title: Download the app
items.text: Get the VOOL App and create an account in a few steps.

items.title: Connect your charger
items.text: Link your VOOL Charger, or any OCPP-compliant charger, to the app.

items.title: Save while charging
items.text: Turn on Smart Charging or set a recurring schedule. Or start and stop by hand.

sections.title: Plug in at six. Charging starts when prices drop.
sections.text: The car waits through the evening price peak and charges in the cheapest hours of the night. It is ready at the time you set.
sections.note: Example hourly prices in ct/kWh, not live data.

sections.alt: Charging statistics in the VOOL App
sections.title: See what charging really costs
sections.text: Price forecasts for the next 24 hours, energy used and money saved per session, and your full charging history.
points: Smart Charging based on Nord Pool prices
Recurring schedules that match your week

sections.alt: Driver using the VOOL App next to a charger
sections.title: For installers too
sections.text: Set up chargers and LMCs in the app, then hand ownership to the customer. You keep remote access to the sites you installed.
